helpFaq.heroLead: Answers to common questions about reporting issues, tracking complaints, and using the MyRoad India mobile app.

questions.q: How do I report a road or infrastructure issue?
questions.a: Open the Report Issue section, select a category and specific issue, add a description and photographs, then submit — your location is captured automatically.

questions.q: Can I report an issue without creating an account?
questions.a: You can register a complaint using the QR-code or mobile-based registration flow; a complaint number is generated for you to track it afterward.

questions.q: What details should I include in my report?
questions.a: Include a clear description, at least one photograph, and make sure your device location is enabled so the issue is pinned accurately on the map.

questions.q: Can I report more than one issue at a time?
questions.a: Yes, each issue should be submitted as a separate report so it gets its own complaint number and can be tracked individually.

questions.q: How do I track the status of my complaint?
questions.a: Use your complaint number in the Track Complaint section to view its current status, history, and complete lifecycle.

questions.q: What do the different complaint statuses mean?
questions.a: Complaints move through Registered, Verified, Assigned, Action, Completed, and Closed — each stage reflects where your complaint is in the resolution process.

questions.q: Will I be notified when my complaint status changes?
questions.a: Yes, you'll receive notifications at registration, verification, assignment, and when the work is completed or resolved.

questions.q: Where can I see all my registered complaints?
questions.a: All complaints you've submitted are listed together in the tracking section, along with their current status and location.

questions.q: Is MyRoad India available as a mobile app?
questions.a: Yes, issues can be reported and tracked directly through the mobile-based registration flow in addition to the website.

questions.q: Can I scan a QR code to report an issue?
questions.a: Yes, QR-code-based registration lets you report an issue quickly by scanning a code at the location of the problem.

questions.q: Does the app work without an internet connection?
questions.a: An active connection is needed to submit a report and capture your GPS location and photographs accurately.

questions.q: Can field staff use the same app to update complaints?
questions.a: Field staff use the same platform to view assigned complaints, upload site photographs, and update work status and remarks.
